about: Queries the user would type into the herd page's Search, each with the chunks it should find: [session_id, sha1(text)[:16]]. The wanted chunks were resolved from `label` (a regex of what they say, optionally within a project) by `session_eval.py label` on a snapshot of the real store. Topics: this repo, features of the user's other projects, general tech -- nothing personal. Labels found by words favour BM25 over the dense half; a query that shares no word with what it wants is what would weigh the dense half fairly.
